description: Adds an option to remove ads in the video player.
name: Video ads

description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.
name: Video quality

description: Fixes the crash at launch on current Android and targets API 25 so that Android 14 and later install the game normally. If the OBB is missing, the game says why. The game is 32-bit only, so the device must still run 32-bit apps.
name: Modern Android compatibility

description: Plays the intro video on the first launch after installing, and skips it after that.

description: Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.

description: Makes the menus, text and pictures full size on screens above 720p, where they are otherwise small. The game is drawn at 720p and stretched to the screen, so it looks slightly blurry.
name: Render at 720p

description: Removes the stutter while firing, caused by the game building a new audio player for every sound.
name: Smooth sound

description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.
name: Stop requests to dead servers

description: A fresh install starts with 999,999,999 Glu credits and 999,999,999 Cash. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.
